requirements.description: The manually screened 2002–2005 8-K restatement cohort, including the full candidate populations, event dates, types, sample exclusions, randomly sampled error cases, retained irregularities, and financial-restatement amounts needed for MAGNITUDE.

required_coverage.population: Paper-defined 2002–2005 restatement announcements and 188 retained cases; 83 errors and 105 irregularities, with 16 regression observations lost to missing data.
required_coverage.detail: Keep the original 8-K cohort cutoff, sampling fractions, 3.9:1 error/irregularity weight and announcement identity. This cohort cutoff does not bound an earlier investigation anchor used in the Table 5 note.

routes.mapping_notes: Audit Analytics fields expose event type, accounting/fraud flags, event/file dates and cumulative-income changes. These are candidate inputs, not a verified match to the paper’s manually coded 8-K cohort or error/irregularity rules.
routes.coverage_notes: The exact bounded probe confirms this file and its fields only. No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation establishes the required historical range, population or identifier completeness.

routes.mapping_notes: Raw filings can be manually screened for the 8-K cohort, but source cohort completeness, hand-coded error/irregularity labels and links to the paper’s 188 rows are not established.
routes.coverage_notes: Unstructured EDGAR filings are a raw document route. They do not by themselves identify the paper’s hand-coded cohort or classification, and full coverage is unverified.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Neither local feed fields nor public filing search verifies the paper’s full cohort, manual category coding, or exact sample-to-firm/date links.

requirements.description: Annual Compustat accounting controls and denominators for year-before-restatement MAGNITUDE, LEVERAGE, ROA and asset-size quintiles.

required_coverage.detail: Allow the 2001 lag for the first 2002 announcement and the fiscal-year alignment between the announcement date and prior fiscal year. No coverage confirmation was supplied.

routes.coverage_notes: The exact bounded probe confirms this file and its fields only. No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation establishes the required historical range, population or identifier completeness.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Exact historical item-number-to-field mappings, eligible-firm coverage and link completeness are unverified.

requirements.description: Historical CEO/CFO identity, CEO ownership and executive departure dates for the Table 5 outcomes and CEO_EQUITY.

required_coverage.frequency: annual executive record and departure date

required_coverage.detail: Equation (1) uses six months on either side of restatement announcement; Table 5 note uses whichever comes first, restatement or investigation announcement. A prior investigation may precede the 2002–2005 filing cohort.

requirements.description: Exact event date used to define six months before/after CEO/CFO departure outcomes.

required_coverage.detail: Equation (1)/Section IV use the restatement announcement, note 28 says the definitive-intention date rather than initial investigation/potential-restatement date, and Table 5 uses whichever is earlier between restatement and investigation announcements.

requirements.description: Underlying 8-K filing text and manual evidence for IRREGULARITY, SUBSIDIARY, REVREC and ANNUAL classifications.

required_coverage.population: Candidate 8-K restatement announcements retained in the 2002–2005 cohort.
required_coverage.detail: The classification section and Table 5 note use different irregularity and subsidiary descriptions. Obtain the source documents and preserve both definitions.

routes.mapping_notes: Raw 8-K documents are needed for manual classification of irregularity, subsidiary scope, revenue-recognition and annual/quarterly restatement indicators. No filing-text classification code or cohort-coverage proof is present.
routes.coverage_notes: Unstructured filings are a candidate manual-coding source; sample completeness and classification are unverified.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Public filing access does not establish the exact cohort or paper-specific manual coding.

variable_coverage.construction: Indicator for the relevant executive departure within a six-month-before/six-month-after window. Equation (1) and Section IV center it on the restatement announcement; page 16 note 28 says the date used is when definitive intention to restate is first announced, not an initial investigation or potential-restatement announcement; the Table 5 note instead anchors the window to the restatement or investigation announcement, whichever is first. The Table 5 first-column heading prints CFO Turnover, although the surrounding results text identifies the first model as CEO turnover.. Preserve the paper-defined timing and population; available field names are candidate inputs and do not by themselves verify the historical crosswalk or coverage.

Indicator equal to 1 when the restatement is classified as an irregularity and 0 otherwise. Section II/III criteria include fraud or irregularity language, SEC/DOJ investigations, or independent investigations; Table 5 note gives a shorter definition based on explicit irregularity language, SEC investigations, or independent board investigations.. Preserve the paper-defined timing and population; available field names are candidate inputs and do not by themselves verify the historical crosswalk or coverage.

Equation (1): indicator equal to 1 if the GAAP violation is isolated in a subsidiary. Table 5 note: 1 if the restatement occurred in a subsidiary. The source does not reconcile these wordings.. Preserve the paper-defined timing and population; available field names are candidate inputs and do not by themselves verify the historical crosswalk or coverage.

Product interaction between the IRREGULARITY indicator and the SUBSIDIARY indicator.. Preserve the paper-defined timing and population; available field names are candidate inputs and do not by themselves verify the historical crosswalk or coverage.

Equation (1) defines MAGNITUDE as the cumulative net-income overstatement scaled by total assets in the year before the restatement announcement. The Table 5 note says amount of net-income overstatement, without the cumulative qualifier.. Preserve the paper-defined timing and population; available field names are candidate inputs and do not by themselves verify the historical crosswalk or coverage.

Indicator equal to 1 if any part of the GAAP violation relates to revenue recognition, and 0 otherwise.. Preserve the paper-defined timing and population; available field names are candidate inputs and do not by themselves verify the historical crosswalk or coverage.

Indicator equal to 1 if the firm restated a 10-K, and 0 if it restated only 10-Qs.. Preserve the paper-defined timing and population; available field names are candidate inputs and do not by themselves verify the historical crosswalk or coverage.

CEO equity ownership stated as a percentage in the year before the restatement in the model-definition section; the Table 5 note instead says fraction of CEO ownership in the year of the restatement, so timing is unresolved.. Preserve the paper-defined timing and population; available field names are candidate inputs and do not by themselves verify the historical crosswalk or coverage.

Debt, identified as Compustat items #9 and #34, divided by assets, identified as Compustat item #6. The descriptive-statistics section states that all variables are measured in the year before the restatement announcement; Table 5's note does not repeat leverage timing.. Preserve the paper-defined timing and population; available field names are candidate inputs and do not by themselves verify the historical crosswalk or coverage.

Equation (1): operating income after depreciation scaled by total assets (Compustat #178/#6). Table 5 note: operating income before interest and taxes scaled by assets (same Compustat items); the source uses both numerator descriptions. The descriptive-statistics text says all variables are measured in the year before the restatement announcement; Table 5's note does not repeat a timing rule for ROA.. Preserve the paper-defined timing and population; available field names are candidate inputs and do not by themselves verify the historical crosswalk or coverage.

design_coverage.reason: The table reports chi-square statistics but does not state a standard-error correction or clustering dimension.
The paper specifies separate weighted logistic regressions; estimator selection is reported and requires no separate external data input.
The displayed equation and Table 5 do not report a fixed-effect family; size-quintile indicators are ordinary regressors.

implementation_issues.description: The turnover window has incompatible source anchors: Equation (1) centers on restatement announcement, note 28 selects definitive intention and excludes an initial investigation date, while Table 5 uses the earlier restatement or investigation announcement. Preserve the first-column CEO narrative versus duplicated printed CFO header as another source conflict.

CEO_EQUITY timing differs (year before versus year of restatement), its numerator/denominator is not defined, and ROA numerator labels differ between operating income after depreciation and operating income before interest and taxes. The source also differs on the scope of SUBSIDIARY and whether MAGNITUDE is cumulative.

The 8-K cohort, error/irregularity labels, subsidiary, revenue-recognition and annual/quarterly classifications require manual source-document coding; the paper says the specific search regex is available from authors on request, which is not obtained here.
The paper reports 1st/99th-percentile winsorization in descriptive statistics but does not explicitly say it is applied to the Table 5 inputs.
